results.title: 4 Important Types of Item Characteristic Curve (ICC) - Careershodh
results.content: Home »MA Psychology Notes»Psychological Testing: Applications»4 Important Types of Item Characteristic Curve (ICC). # 4 Important Types of Item Characteristic Curve (ICC). **Item Characteristic Curve (ICC)** is a graphical representation of relationship between the **probability of correct P(θ)** response and a **test takers ability (θ).**  It is used to evaluate the psychometric properties of tests like reliability, difficulty, and discriminatory power. ICC is a mathematical equation that describes the relation between the amount of a latent trait an individual possesses and the probability that he or she will give a designated response to a test item designed to measure that construct. **Item Characteristic Curve (ICC)** graphically depict the relationship between an individual’s ability level and their probability of answering an item correctly, while IRT provides a theoretical framework for understanding item behavior and improving the efficiency and validity of assessments. ## **Item Characteristic Curve (ICC)**. The ICC is plotted with the total test score, an approximation of the **latent trait**, on the horizontal (X) axis, and the **proportion of test-takers** answering the item correctly on the vertical (Y) axis (Aiken, 2008). Each item in a test has its own item characteristic curve. ### **Purpose of** **Item Characteristic Curve (ICC)**. Second, ICCs help **identify items that may not function as expected**, such as those that fail to discriminate between different ability levels or that unfairly favor certain groups of test-takers. ### **Drawing** **Item Characteristic Curve (ICC)**. The proportion of test-takers in each category who answered the item correctly is then plotted against the corresponding ability level. Item Characteristic Curve ICC for several items. ## **Types of Item Characteristic Curves (ICC)**. **Item Characteristic Curves (ICC)** for a Good Item. A flat curve suggests that test-takers at all ability levels have an equal chance of answering correctly, indicating the item does not measure the intended trait. **Item Characteristic Curves (ICC)** for a Poor Item. Occasionally, ICCs show a downward slope at high ability levels, which may occur when highly knowledgeable test-takers overthink or misinterpret the item. ICCs provide valuable insights into item discrimination and difficulty, while IRT allows for the development of more reliable, valid, and adaptive tests. *4 Important Types of Item Characteristic Curve (ICC)*.

results.title: How to add Validation Agents in SAP to validate PO’s via ICC validation – Opentext | +jonu joy
results.content: We had an issue when a new user joined and wasnt able to validate documents, the validation agents are seen from tcode /n/OPT/VIM\_7AX8. * Use transaction code /n/OPT/VIM\_7AX8 to view the status of DP document. Once the extraction is completed on ICC, the status of DP document in SAP is changed to (73) EXTRACTION COMPLETED. * The DP trigger Job changes the status of DP document to (74) READY FOR VALIDATION. * The ICC Validation Client, or the Customizing Client, respectively, polls for all documents from SAP with status 74. Once the validation team submits the DP document on ICC, the status of DP document changes to (76) VALIDATION COMPLETE. * The DP trigger job moves the DP document to VIM Workflow. If all the fields are extracted correctly and business rules are validated invoice is posted in SAP. VIM Workflow should be configured to trigger the DP to respective team in case of business rule validation failures.
